entities.summary: Galina Olegovna Voskoboeva is a Russian-born Kazakhstani tennis player. She reached career-high rankings of world No. 42 in singles and No. 26 in doubles. She won five doubles titles on the WTA Tour, as well as one doubles title on the WTA Challenger Tour. She also won three singles titles and 13 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit.
